2) Short recorded product tour + async Q&A — I’ll send a 6–8 minute tailored recording and we can follow up in-thread.

If either works, reply with a preferred day/time (or say "recording please") and I’ll lock it in. Attached is a one-pager (concierge-guide.pdf) that covers what we'll show and recommended pre-call checklist.

Thanks — quick replies welcome; we try to keep these recovery options tight so customers can move forward with the trial.
